messages.author: 7e01961f1f4ce874
messages.subject: Error in as(unlist(x[[i]]), class(template[[i]])) : no method or default for coercing “character” to
parts:
Hi All,

I am getting error while using mr jobs output in native format as input to another mr job.
I am getting following error in JT logs.


Error in as(unlist(x[[i]]), class(template[[i]])) : 

  no method or default for coercing “character” to “factor”

Calls: <Anonymous> ... keys -> from.list -> to.data.frame -> lapply -> FUN -> as


-----------------------------------------------------------

Samle csv file which I am using has only two lines 

1,a

2,b


-------------------------------------------------------------------
Sys.setenv(HADOOP_CMD="/usr/bin/hadoop")
library(rmr2)

table1.cols = c("sno","name")
table1.format = make.input.format('csv', 'text', sep=',' , col.names=table1.cols )

Mapper <- function(key, columns){
  output.key    = data.frame( sno  = columns$sno , name       = columns$name)
  output.value  = data.frame( sno  = columns$sno , name       = columns$name)
  keyval( output.key, output.value )
}

MapReduce <- function(inputPath, inputFormat, outputPath = NULL){
  mapreduce( input = inputPath,
             output = outputPath,
             input.format = inputFormat,
             map = Mapper,
             verbose=T
  )
}

table1.path='/sample'
table1.data= MapReduce(table1.path, table1.format)
tempfile = mapreduce( input = table1.data,verbose=T)
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Line in bold above is giving error, whats going wrong here ?

Hi,
this is a known bug that's fixed in master (upcoming 3.1.1). We are still ironing out a few problems, so you may want to wait for the release or build from master and give it a shot. Another option would be to avoid factors altogether, I think if you use the option stringsAsFactors  = FALSE when you create the input format you could work around the problem.


Antonio
